description: This file contains shell functions and variables related to package upgrade routines, including file installation, hook execution, magic number detection, partition management, and firmware flashing operations.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies or links files into the RAM_ROOT directory, handling symlinks and regular files.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs executable files and their library dependencies.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Runs specified hook functions with given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no response, considering default.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON encoding.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Detects the filesystem type mounted at root.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads image data from a source file, attempting decompression based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Reads image data with dd filtering and progress filtering.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Detects magic word (file format signature) for an image.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Detects long magic value to identify image format.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads GPT partition table signature.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads VFAT signature.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads FAT32 signature.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies image type from magic number.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks if partition is EFI.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks if partition is FAT/FAT32.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Detects and exports the boot device information.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports the partition device based on boot device info.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a little-endian 32-bit hex string to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table information from a device or image file.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to indicate upgrade in progress.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade with optional backup, writing to MTD device.
